## Delivery contract

- Stage / milestone:
- Linked work item(s):

## Contract and ownership

- Public/private contract changes:
- Consumers migrated:
- Obsolete contracts or compatibility paths removed:
- Files owned by this change:
- Accepted ADRs followed or added:

## Verification evidence

- Exact focused commands and observed results:
- Exact integrated commands and observed results:
- Installed/package smoke evidence:
- Real-surface scenario and observed result:
- Kernel/process/artifact state after failure paths:
- Hosted CI run / required-check names:

## Review gates

- [ ] Architecture and delivery-stage boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] No platform semantics entered the core without accepted evidence.
- [ ] State and cleanup claims match observed behavior.
- [ ] Required tests fail for plausible regressions.
- [ ] Independent reviewer has no unresolved Blocker or Major finding.
- [ ] Built artifacts install and run through the real entry point when applicable.
- [ ] Canonical GitHub Project and linked issues reflect the resulting state.
- [ ] Documentation changed only where verified project truth changed.
